segments.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my youtube channel, Safety Management Study
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到我的 YouTube 频道 Safety Management Study。

segments.text: In today's video, I am going to share my first interview experience
segments.zh: 在今天的视频中，我要分享我的第一次面试经历。

segments.text: In these days, I am working as a safety officer in Saudi Arabia
segments.zh: 这段时间，我在沙特阿拉伯担任安全员。

segments.text: This is the first time when I am working in a Gulf country
segments.zh: 这是我第一次在海湾国家工作。

segments.text: I have worked here in Sabik Affiliated, two petrochemical plants
segments.zh: 我在这里的 SABIC 下属的两家石化厂工作过，

segments.zh: 第一家是 Saudi Kayan，第二家是 Yansab。

segments.text: So today, I am going to tell you what questions were asked in my first interview
segments.zh: 所以今天，我要告诉你们我第一次面试时被问到了哪些问题，

segments.text: So, let's start today's video

segments.text: The first question is, what are the roles of a safety officer?
segments.zh: 第一个问题是：安全员的职责是什么？

segments.text: What is the role of a safety officer?
segments.zh: 安全员的职责是什么？

segments.text: You can answer it like this
segments.zh: 你可以这样回答。

segments.text: The first role of a safety officer is to advise management on health and safety aspects of an organization
segments.zh: 安全员的第一项职责是就组织的健康与安全方面向管理层提供建议。

segments.text: That is, the first job of a safety officer is to advise the management on health and safety
segments.zh: 也就是说，安全员的第一项工作是就健康与安全向管理层提供建议。

segments.text: Second is to monitor the work place activities and ensure that all activities are being carried with required safety rules
segments.zh: 第二是监督工作场所的各项活动，确保所有活动都按照规定的安全规则进行。

segments.text: You have to monitor any activities that are going on in the work place
segments.zh: 你要监督工作场所正在进行的任何活动，

segments.text: You have to see if any of the rules are being followed or not
segments.zh: 你要看各项规则是否得到遵守。

segments.text: Third is to create safety awareness through TBT
segments.zh: 第三是通过 TBT 提高安全意识。

segments.text: That is, you have to create safety awareness through Toolbox Talk
segments.zh: 也就是说，你要通过班前安全讲话（Toolbox Talk）提高安全意识。

segments.text: Next is to identify hazards and suggest suitable control measures for all activities
segments.zh: 下一项是识别危害，并为所有活动提出合适的控制措施。

segments.text: You have to identify any of the hazards that are going on in the site activity
segments.zh: 你要识别现场活动中存在的任何危害，

segments.text: And how to control them, that is what you have to suggest
segments.zh: 以及如何控制它们，这就是你要提出的建议。

segments.text: Next is to conduct safety training, meetings, program, inspection and audit
segments.zh: 下一项是组织安全培训、会议、计划、检查和审核。

segments.text: You have to conduct safety training, meetings, conduct, inspection, all of these are your work
segments.zh: 你要组织安全培训、会议、检查，这些都是你的工作。

segments.text: Next is to participate in preparation of JSA, SOP, safety plan, rescue plan and safety manuals
segments.zh: 下一项是参与编制 JSA、SOP、安全计划、救援计划和安全手册。

segments.text: You have to participate in preparing JSA, SOP and JSA
segments.zh: 你要参与编制 JSA、SOP 和 JSA。

segments.text: Participate in accident investigation and safety audit
segments.zh: 参与事故调查和安全审核。

segments.text: You have to participate in accident investigation and do the investigation
segments.zh: 你要参与事故调查并进行调查。

segments.zh: 下一个问题是：什么是 JSA？

segments.text: You can define them as

segments.text: Isotopes are one or more types of atoms
segments.zh: 同位素是一种或多种原子，

segments.text: which have different mass number but same atomic number

segments.zh: 同位素是质量数不同的原子，

segments.text: Next question is what is TWA?
segments.zh: 下一个问题是：什么是 TWA？

segments.text: What is the average time weight?
segments.zh: 什么是时间加权平均值？

segments.text: You can define it as
segments.zh: 你可以这样定义：

segments.text: TWA means the concentration of contaminants
segments.zh: TWA 是指空气中污染物的浓度，

segments.text: in the air in which worker can be exposed for 8 hours a day
segments.zh: 工人在该浓度下每天暴露 8 小时、

segments.text: and 40 hours in a week without adverse health effects
segments.zh: 每周 40 小时，不会产生不良健康影响。

segments.text: In the air, the amount of contaminants or toxic gases
segments.zh: 空气中污染物或有毒气体的含量，

segments.text: in which a worker can work without any health
segments.zh: 工人在该含量下工作而不影响任何健康，

segments.text: is called TWA
segments.zh: 就叫做 TWA。

segments.text: For example, TWA is 10 ppm
segments.zh: 例如，TWA 为 10 ppm。

segments.text: If TWA is 10 ppm, you can work for 8 hours a day
segments.zh: 如果 TWA 为 10 ppm，你可以每天工作 8 小时。

segments.text: Next question is what is HTEL?
segments.zh: 下一个问题是：什么是 STEL？

segments.text: You can define it as
segments.zh: 你可以这样定义：

segments.text: short term exposure limit means
segments.zh: 短时间接触限值是指

segments.text: the maximum concentration of chemical or toxic gases
segments.zh: 化学品或有毒气体的最高浓度，

segments.text: at which a worker can be exposed for up to 15 minutes
segments.zh: 工人在该浓度下可以暴露最长 15 分钟，

segments.text: without any adverse health effects
segments.zh: 而不会产生任何不良健康影响。

segments.text: What is the maximum amount of toxic gases
segments.zh: 有毒气体的最高含量是多少，

segments.text: In which a worker can work without any health effects for 15 minutes
segments.zh: 工人在该含量下工作 15 分钟不会产生任何健康影响，

segments.text: is called HTEL
segments.zh: 就叫做 STEL。

segments.text: For example, H2S has 15 ppm
segments.zh: 例如，H2S 是 15 ppm。

segments.text: If 15 ppm is H2S, a worker can work for 15 minutes
segments.zh: 如果 H2S 为 15 ppm，工人可以工作 15 分钟。

segments.text: What is flashpoint?
segments.zh: 什么是闪点？

segments.text: Flashpoint is the minimum temperature at which the vapor produced from a fuel
segments.zh: 闪点是燃料产生的蒸气

segments.text: will ignite with the presence of an ignition source
segments.zh: 在有点火源存在时会被点燃的最低温度。

segments.zh: 也就是说，闪点是燃料中产生蒸气的最低温度，

segments.text: and if a ignition source is given in that vapor, then it will be a fire
segments.zh: 如果给这些蒸气一个点火源，就会起火。

segments.zh: 在有点火源存在时被点燃并至少持续燃烧 5 秒钟

segments.text: at the presence of an ignition source

segments.zh: 也就是说，闪点是燃料中产生蒸气的最低温度，

segments.zh: 当它被点火源点燃后，会持续燃烧至少 5 秒钟。

segments.text: Next is what is LEL and UVL?
segments.zh: 下一个是：什么是 LEL 和 UEL？

segments.text: i.e. what is the lower explosive limit and upper explosive limit?
segments.zh: 也就是说，什么是爆炸下限和爆炸上限？

segments.text: So LEL is the minimum concentration of a flammable vapor
segments.zh: LEL 是易燃蒸气在有点火源存在时

segments.text: which can burn at the presence of an ignition source

segments.zh: 也就是说，LEL 是易燃蒸气在有任何点火源存在时

segments.text: which can burn at the presence of any ignition source
segments.zh: 能够燃烧的最低浓度。

segments.text: UVL is the maximum concentration of flammable vapor

segments.text: which will burn at the presence of an ignition source

segments.zh: 什么是 NFPA704？

segments.text: NFPA704 is a system which provides the chemical information and severity of hazard related to chemical.
segments.zh: NFPA704 是一个提供化学品信息以及与化学品相关的危害严重程度的体系。

segments.text: NFPA704 is a system which provides the chemical information and the severity of hazard related to chemical.
segments.zh: NFPA704 是一个提供化学品信息以及与化学品相关的危害严重程度的体系。

segments.text: The four colors of fire diamonds are red, blue, yellow and white.
segments.zh: 火灾菱形标识的四种颜色是红、蓝、黄、白。

segments.text: Next question is, what is Permit to Work?
segments.zh: 下一个问题是：什么是工作许可证？

segments.text: You can define Permit to Work's written authorization issued by an authorized person to a requester to carry out the activity for a certain location, for a certain period of time with safety precautions.
segments.zh: 你可以这样定义工作许可证：它是由授权人员签发给申请人的书面授权，允许其在特定地点、特定时间段内，在采取安全防范措施的前提下开展作业活动。

segments.text: Permit to Work is an authorization to carry out any activity which is issued by an authorized person who receives a requester who works with full safety precautions.
segments.zh: 工作许可证是开展任何作业活动的授权，由授权人员签发，接收者是在采取全面安全防范措施的前提下作业的申请人。

segments.text: Next question is, what are the types of Permit?
segments.zh: 下一个问题是：许可证有哪些类型？

segments.text: There are many types of Permit.
segments.zh: 许可证有很多种类型。

segments.text: There are many people who are confused.
segments.zh: 很多人对此感到困惑。

segments.text: Each industry has its own Permit system.
segments.zh: 每个行业都有自己的许可证制度。

segments.text: The Permit to Work is of eight types.
segments.zh: 工作许可证有八种类型。

segments.text: The first is General Work Permit.
segments.zh: 第一种是一般作业许可证。

segments.text: The second is Hot Work Permit.
segments.zh: 第二种是动火作业许可证。

segments.text: The third is Electrical Work Permit.
segments.zh: 第三种是电气作业许可证。

segments.text: The fourth is Confined Space Entry Work Permit.
segments.zh: 第四种是受限空间进入作业许可证。

segments.text: The fifth is Excavation Work Permit.
segments.zh: 第五种是开挖作业许可证。

segments.text: The sixth is Radiation Work Permit.
segments.zh: 第六种是辐射作业许可证。

segments.text: The seventh is Lifting Work Permit.
segments.zh: 第七种是吊装作业许可证。

segments.text: The eighth is High Pressure Jating Work Permit.
segments.zh: 第八种是高压喷射作业许可证。

segments.text: These are all Permits which are used in the industry.
segments.zh: 这些都是行业中使用的许可证。

segments.text: Next question is, what is Lotto?
segments.zh: 下一个问题是：什么是 LOTO？

segments.text: It is a Locker Tagout.
segments.zh: 它就是上锁挂牌（Lockout Tagout）。

segments.text: You can define it as Lotto or Safety Procedure used to isolate energy equipment to prevent unauthorized operation during work on equipment.
segments.zh: 你可以这样定义：LOTO 是一种安全程序，用于隔离设备的能量，防止在设备上作业时发生未经授权的操作。

segments.text: Lotto is a safety procedure which is used to isolate any energy equipment so that it does not flow from any mistake or unauthorized operation where any person is working.
segments.zh: LOTO 是一种安全程序，用于隔离任何带能量的设备，使其在有人作业的地方不会因任何失误或未经授权的操作而释放能量。

segments.zh: 第一是准备。

segments.zh: 第二是实施 LOTO 隔离。

segments.zh: 第三是安装 LOTO 装置。

segments.text: Fourth is Try Out and Verification.

segments.zh: 什么是受限空间？

segments.zh: 你可以这样定义：受限空间是进出途径有限的空间。

segments.zh: 照明不足、通风不足以及有毒气体等问题。

segments.text: What are the hazards in Confined Space?
segments.zh: 受限空间内有哪些危害？

segments.text: You can define it as Oxygen Deficiency, Oxygen Enrichment,
segments.zh: 你可以这样回答：缺氧、富氧、

segments.text: Light of Illumination, Light of Ventilation and Toxic Gas.
segments.zh: 照明不足、通风不足以及有毒气体。

segments.text: Next question is, what are the requirements to work inside Confined Space?
segments.zh: 下一个问题是：在受限空间内作业有哪些要求？

segments.text: What are the requirements to work in Confined Space?
segments.zh: 在受限空间内作业有哪些要求？

segments.text: First is Permit to Work, Lotto, Purging, Ventilation,
segments.zh: 首先是工作许可证、LOTO、吹扫置换、通风、

segments.text: Lighting, Gas Test,
segments.zh: 照明、气体检测、

segments.text: Hole Watcher with Lock Seat, Training, Rescue Plan, etc.
segments.zh: 带记录表的进出口监护人、培训、救援计划等。

segments.text: Next is, what is Critical Lifting?
segments.zh: 下一个是：什么是关键吊装？

segments.text: What is Critical Lifting?
segments.zh: 什么是关键吊装？

segments.text: What Liftings will you call as Critical Lifting?
segments.zh: 哪些吊装你会称之为关键吊装？

segments.text: There are many conditions for this.
segments.zh: 这方面有很多条件。

segments.text: First is, Lifting over Energized Equipment.
segments.zh: 第一，在带电设备上方吊装。

segments.text: If you are lifting over Energized Equipment,
segments.zh: 如果你在带电设备上方吊装，

segments.text: then this is Critical Lifting.
segments.zh: 那么这就是关键吊装。

segments.text: Any lifting exceeds 75% of the crane rated Capacity.
segments.zh: 任何超过起重机额定起重量 75% 的吊装。

segments.text: If you are lifting 75% of the crane's Capacity,
segments.zh: 如果你吊装的重量达到起重机额定起重量的 75%，

segments.text: then this is Critical Lifting.
segments.zh: 那么这就是关键吊装。

segments.text: Third is Tenderm Lifting.
segments.zh: 第三是双机抬吊。

segments.text: If you are using multiple cranes to lift a load,
segments.zh: 如果你使用多台起重机吊装一个重物，

segments.text: then this is also a Critical Lifting.
segments.zh: 那么这也是关键吊装。

segments.text: Next question is, what is SDS?
segments.zh: 下一个问题是：什么是 SDS？

segments.text: What is the Safety Data Seat?
segments.zh: 什么是安全技术说明书？

segments.text: Safety Data Seat is a document that provides detailed information
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书是一份提供化学物质性质详细信息的文件，

segments.text: about the nature of chemical substance,
segments.zh: 内容包括

segments.text: such as physical and chemical properties,
segments.zh: 理化性质，

segments.text: information of health, safety and environment hazards.
segments.zh: 以及健康、安全和环境危害信息。

segments.text: That is, what is SDS?
segments.zh: 也就是说，什么是 SDS？

segments.text: Safety Data Seat.
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书。

segments.text: This is a document that is given about the chemical.
segments.zh: 这是一份随化学品一起提供的文件。

segments.text: What are the properties of the chemical?
segments.zh: 该化学品有哪些性质？

segments.text: What are its hazards?
segments.zh: 它有哪些危害？

segments.text: How to control it?
segments.zh: 如何加以控制？

segments.text: There are 16 sections in total.
segments.zh: 总共有 16 个部分。

segments.text: Next question is, for manual excavation,
segments.zh: 下一个问题是：对于人工开挖，

segments.text: more than 1.2 meter depth,
segments.zh: 深度超过 1.2 米时，

segments.text: which work permit is mandatory?
segments.zh: 必须办理哪种工作许可证？

segments.text: If you are doing manual excavation,
segments.zh: 如果你在进行人工开挖，

segments.text: and the depth is more than 1.2 meter,
segments.zh: 而且深度超过 1.2 米，

segments.text: then which permit you will have to take?
segments.zh: 那么你必须办理哪种许可证？

segments.text: The answer is Confined Space Entry Work Permit.
segments.zh: 答案是受限空间进入作业许可证。
